replies.reply:
在 UKPDS 34 中，超重（>120% 理想体重）新诊断 2 型糖尿病患者接受二甲双胍强化血糖控制，与常规治疗（以饮食为主）相比，任何糖尿病相关终点的风险下降 32%（95% CI 13–47，p=0.002）[1]。

**补充说明**：这是意向性治疗分析的相对风险下降，中位随访 10.7 年（二甲双胍组 342 例 vs 常规组 411 例）；同组分析中糖尿病相关死亡下降 42%（9–63）、全因死亡下降 36%（9–55），中位 HbA1c 为 7.4% vs 8.0% [1]。需要注意对照为常规治疗而非安慰剂，且为开放标签设计，因此该效应量同时包含降糖强度本身的贡献，不能完全归因于二甲双胍的药物特异性作用；另一项补充试验中，已用最大剂量磺脲类者加用二甲双胍反而与糖尿病相关死亡风险升高相关（+96%，95% CI 2–275），提示这一结论不能外推到磺脲类联合二甲双胍的场景 [1]。

**证据层级**：以上数据来自该试验的摘要级记录，本次未能获取开放获取全文，随机化比例、分配隐藏与终点裁定流程等细节未逐项核实；若需精确的事件数、绝对风险差或全因死亡的分组事件率，应以全文为准 [1]。

参考文献：

[1] UK Prospective Diabetes Study (UKPDS) Group. Effect of intensive blood-glucose control with metformin on complications in overweight patients with type 2 diabetes (UKPDS 34). *Lancet*. 1998;352(9131):854-865. PMID: 9742977. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9742977/

1. 二甲双胍单药治疗可使 2 型糖尿病患者的 HbA1c 较安慰剂降低约 1.5 个百分点 [1]（CLM-001）。

claims.claim: 一项在荷兰两家二级医疗中心开展的多中心随机对照试验纳入 437 例 65 岁以上、卒中风险升高的患者，180 天智能手表监测组新发房颤 9.6%，常规照护组 2.3%。

sources.title: Enhanced Detection and Prompt Diagnosis of Atrial Fibrillation Using Apple Watch: A Randomized Controlled Trial
sources.quote: Between November 2022 and December 2023, 437 patients were randomized (219 intervention, 218 control)
sources.text: BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF), the most common cardiac arrhythmia, is a major cause of stroke and often remains undiagnosed due to its paroxysmal and frequently asymptomatic nature. Wearables provide a scalable, noninvasive screening tool. OBJECTIVES: This trial evaluated new onset AF detection in patients at elevated stroke risk using remote smartwatch-based screening. METHODS: This prospective multicenter randomized controlled trial included patients ≥65 years with elevated stroke risk (CHA 2 DS 2 -VASc ≥2 men, ≥3 women) from 2 secondary care centers in the Netherlands. Patients were randomized to 6-month (180-day) monitoring with a smartwatch with photoplethysmography and single-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) functions, or standard care. ECGs were reviewed remotely by an independent eHealth team within 24 hours. The primary outcome was new onset AF, defined as a confirmed episode lasting ≥30 seconds on single-lead ECG or standard ECG methods. RESULTS: Between November 2022 and December 2023, 437 patients were randomized (219 intervention, 218 control); the median age was 75 years, 46.7% were female and the median CHA 2 DS 2 -VASc score was 3.0. New onset AF occurred in 21 (9.6%) patients of the intervention group and 5 (2.3%) patients of the control group (risk difference: 7.3 percentage points; 95% CI: 2.9-11.7 percentage points; P = 0.001; HR: 4.40; 95% CI: 1.66-11.66). Several asymptomatic AF episodes were detected only in the intervention group, while paroxysmal AF occurred in both groups. CONCLUSIONS: This randomized controlled trial provides evidence that 6-month smartwatch-based AF screening enhances the detection rate of new onset AF compared with standard care in patients at elevated stroke risk. (Detection and Quantification of Atrial Fibrillation in High-risk Patients Using a Smartwatch Wearable [Apple Watch] [EQUAL]; NCT05686330).

expectClean.why: every detail of the claim is in the abstract; the incident was advice to delete correct details the editor had not been shown. A note that the effect size is missing is fair editing, whatever kind the model files it under.
